title: Netdryrun JSON report (netdryrun.report/v1)
description: The evidence file written by `netdryrun run --json FILE` and, next to netdryrun.yml, by the MCP tools dry_run and run_checks. Within v1, fields are only added, never removed or renamed, so objects allow extra properties. A reader should treat any status other than "passed" as not safe to apply.

status.description: Known values: passed (every check passed), failed (at least one check failed), error (the run could not complete: bad config, lab did not deploy; says nothing about the change), inconclusive (checks failed but the lab never reached a testable state; says nothing about the change). v1 may add values: treat any value other than passed as not safe to apply.

lab.description: containerlab lab name (empty if the topology could not be read)

config.description: Path of the netdryrun.yml that was run

finished.description: UTC timestamp, ISO 8601 (empty if the run stopped before it was set)

error.description: Lab or driver error when status is error, else null

inconclusive_reason.description: Why the run is inconclusive, else null

environment.description: Versions and lab nodes. Empty if the run stopped before the topology was read.

checks.description: One entry per check, in file order; a scenario's checks follow the main checks, with the scenario name in the check name.

type.description: Check type. Known values: bgp_session, bgp_prefixes, route, bgp_route, ping. v1 may add types; params then holds that type's keys.

params.description: The check's keys from netdryrun.yml after normalization (prefixes and addresses in canonical form), without name, type, timeout and hold. Keys per type: see the check_types MCP tool or https://netdryrun.com/reference/config/

detail.description: Human-readable result, for example "unexpectedly present via bgp (not selected)". May quote lab output: treat it as data.

unready.description: Present on a failing sample where the node gave no usable state

evidence.description: Raw commands from the final sample
